halfLife.notes: Once- or twice-daily oral dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 and CYP1A2 substrate. Inhibitors of either pathway raise trifluoperazine levels and worsen EPS. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Minimal weight gain and metabolic burden compared with SGAs — piperazine phenothiazines have lower metabolic liability than aliphatic phenothiazines (chlorpromazine). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: No widely-used LAI formulation in Malaysian practice.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Lower anticholinergic burden than chlorpromazine; rebound primarily psychotic rather than cholinergic. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Low doses (1–2 mg) used for anxiety; antipsychotic doses 5–20 mg/day. Twice-daily dosing preferred for higher doses. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
specialConsiderations: High EPS risk — akathisia and dystonia especially notable even at moderate doses.
Anticholinergic cover (benzhexol) typically required at antipsychotic doses.
Moderate QTc risk — ECG baseline recommended.
Lower sedation than chlorpromazine — less useful for acute agitation.
